title: Remove the Playwright browser runtime and its Playwright dependency
summary: Hard-cut removal of the Host browser runtime and its Playwright dependency after the concrete providers were retired. Deletes the five browser adapter modules (browser_session, browser_readonly, browser_action, browser_recovery, browser_evidence) and the now-dead adapter layer they exclusively used (page, object_identity, action_safety, recovery, evidence, locale_terms), their public exports, their tests, the browser/test Playwright extras, the raised Chromium readiness check and related build, test-runner, resilience-scan, and English-text allowlist references, and refreshes uv.lock and the release wheelhouse note. This is a continuation of remove-concrete-providers (no browser provider is published and missing capability fails closed); it does not supersede that record. The provider-facing contract is retained: the SDK BrowserSnapshot / BrowserSnapshotSource types and the compiled input.kind browser_snapshot remain valid, so declaration-only plugins such as frontend-audit still compile without runtime code. The persisted operationKind vocabulary (browser_action, recovery) and recovery dimensions are unchanged; this record does not touch schema or ledger migration. Documentation and README wording are deferred to the immediately following Group 1 design confirmation so no committed README contradicts the code. Implementation evidence: this change landed in 58ad244, the commit that added this record, and remains in force at 66e7e45; 58ad244 was pushed without a recorded Verification run, so the record is carried as implemented rather than verified.

platform: The platform kernel and Host own the removal of the browser runtime, its Playwright dependency, and the dead adapter layer
plugin: No plugin change; declaration-only plugins such as frontend-audit remain compile-only and untouched
provider: No provider change; no browser provider is published, matching remove-concrete-providers
agent: The Agent performs no runtime capability work under this record

forbiddenResponsibilities: The removed Host browser runtime must not be reintroduced without a new approved design confirmation
The SDK BrowserSnapshot / BrowserSnapshotSource contract and the compiled input.kind browser_snapshot must not be removed by this record
The persisted operationKind vocabulary and recovery dimensions must not be changed by this record
No existing approved design record may be edited or backdated
acceptance: No module in src/ imports the removed browser runtime or dead adapter modules
scripts/run_tests.py fast and full both pass with no skips and no required real-browser behaviors
The three boundary gates, the English-text gate, and check_design_confirmation.py --git-range HEAD pass
uv.lock regenerates with changes limited to Playwright and its now-unused transitive dependencies
The SDK BrowserSnapshot contract and browser_snapshot input kind still compile frontend-audit without runtime code

humanApproval.decision: The user directed removal of the browser capability together with its tests and related code, and the reviewer verified the exact 33-path change list before execution.
